unit.why: A short narrative of the last day and death of the holy master: he removes his tefillin, speaks his final words, cleaves to God all day, and dies that night.
unit.boundary_note: The last line ('חידושים ומאמרים מתוקים...') is a heading for the following section of teachings and belongs with the next division.

stories.start_quote: ואמנם מורינו הקדוש בעצמו לא חפץ בחיים
stories.end_quote: נצחו אראלים את המצוקים ועלה השמימה זיע״א
stories.summary_en: The holy master, weary of the coarse world, removes his tefillin on his last day (Isru Hag of Shavuot), declares himself exempt from the commandments, spends the day in deep devekut and dies that night.

tags.why: The whole narrative is a deathbed scene with last words.
